SetupSubtitle: Needed once. You can change everything later in the settings.
BrowseTitle: Choose the SCUM or SCUM Server folder
PathEmpty: Choose the folder where SCUM or SCUM Server is installed.
PaksNotFound: No SCUM Paks folder here. Choose the folder that contains SCUM\Content\Paks.
KeyRequired: The editor needs the key: recipes, cookbooks and icons are read straight from the game files. The key stays on this computer, encrypted.
WhereKeyText: SCUM's files are encrypted. Modders use the AES key in tools like FModel — ask in the SCUM modding community. The editor uses the key only to read recipes, cookbooks and icons from the game on this computer and never sends it anywhere.
KeyBadFormat: The key is 64 hex digits, optionally starting with 0x.
KeyChecking: Checking the key on the game files…
KeyWrong: This key does not open the game files. Check that it is for the current version.
OpenFolderTitle: Choose a project folder (the one with modkit.json)
NotAProject: This folder has no modkit.json. Choose a project folder or create a new project.
NoProjectsText: Create a project on the right or open a folder that contains modkit.json.
ReadOnlyTip: This project was not made in the editor. For now it opens for viewing only: modkit.json is not changed.
NumberNote: Number {0} is the first free one. Use Latin letters, digits and _ in the name.
NameInvalid: Latin letters, digits and _ only, up to 40 characters.
NameTaken: A project with this name already exists.
ProjectFolderTitle: Where to create the project folder
FolderTaken: This folder already holds a project.
ProjectInfo: A project keeps only your edits. It does not change the game until you build the mod.
BadgeKeyTip: The AES key opens the game files.
HiddenLine: in no cookbook and not known from the start
HiddenTip: Nobody can learn this recipe in the game: it is in no cookbook and not in the known-from-the-start list.
LoadFailed: Could not read the recipes from the game
NothingFoundText: Try another dish or ingredient name.
PickRecipe: Choose a recipe on the left
ReadOnlyStatus: View only: this project was not made in the editor, modkit.json is not changed
PickNewSlot: First variant of the new slot
AddSlotTip: New slot: choose an item, its name becomes the slot title
Legend: Blue corner: slot added by the mod; orange: changed; struck out: removed. The number at the top right is how many variants fit.
ResetTip: Back to the game's recipe (you can still change your mind before saving)
SavedStatus: All edits are saved to modkit.json
NotBuiltStatus: Edits are saved, but the mod was not built since
BuiltStatus: Edits are saved, the mod is built and installed
PickSlot: Choose a slot to change its title, variants and amount.
PickSlotView: Choose a slot to see its variants.
SlotRemovedText: This slot is removed from the recipe: the game will not have it.
CaptionVerbatim: Your own title is shown in the game as it is, not translated.
LiquidNote: A liquid can come in any container. The amount is in litres (0.25 = 250 ml).
NutrientNote: How much of the item's nutrition goes into the dish (usually 100 % in the game).
UnsavedText: The project has unsaved recipe edits. Save them to modkit.json?
AddVariantTip: Another item or liquid that fits
InstallAfterBuild: Install into the game right after the build
SaveToFolder: Save the mod to a folder
FolderHint: You get {0}.pak and .sig, for a server or Nexus. ~mods and the shared registry are not touched.
GameRunningBuild: SCUM is running and keeps the mod files open. Close the game (or the server), then build.
SpawnTitle: Commands to test it in the game
StepInstallFailed: Could not put the mod into ~mods
StepRegistry: Building the shared registry of mods…
StepRegistryOk: Shared registry built, mods in it: {0}, all included
StepRegistryWarn: Shared registry built (mods: {0}), but not everything is fine
StepRegistryFailed: The shared registry did not build
GameRunning: SCUM is running: close the game
BuildReadOnlyTip: This project was not made in the editor and builds with its own script (Food_Mod: build.sh).
UpdateRegistry: Update the shared registry of mods
MergerNoRelease: Could not get the ScumRegistryMerger release from GitHub. Check the internet or download it from the project page.
StepClones: Clones of dishes, recipes and cookbooks
StepEdits: Edits of recipes, cookbooks, the recipe registry
StepCheck: Checking the packages against the game
StepRegistrySkipped: The shared registry was not updated (unchecked)
StepRegistryNoMerger: Shared registry: the program is not installed (download it above)
SecGameLead: The SCUM client or server: recipes, cookbooks and icons are read from its files, and mods are installed there.
KeyStoredHint: The key stays on this computer, encrypted for your Windows user, and is never sent anywhere.
SetAutoSaveDesc: Save the project right after every edit (no Ctrl+S)
SetFirstNumberDesc: New projects get the first free number from here (901 → pakchunk901-Name_P.pak)
SetInstallDefault: Install into the game by default
SetInstallDefaultDesc: "Install into the game" in the build window starts checked
SecMergerLead: Builds the shared registry so new recipes and cookbooks of several mods work together. The editor runs it after a build and checks its version.
SetCheckUpdatesDesc: Of this program and of ScumRegistryMerger
SetUseMergerSettings: Take the game folder and key from ScumRegistryMerger
SetCheckNow: Check the version on GitHub now
SetLanguageNote: The program's language. Names of recipes, cookbooks and food come from the game's localization in the same language.
SetEditorReleases: This copy of the program. New versions come from its GitHub releases.
AboutText: SCUM Recipe Editor helps the SCUM community change cooking without the Unreal editor: edit recipes, add your own dishes and cookbooks, build ready mods for players and servers. The program is free and open source: share recipes, report bugs and send ideas.
AboutVersion: SCUM Recipe Editor {0}: cooked content of Unreal Engine 4.27.2
SettingsGameText: Set the SCUM folder and the AES key: without them the editor cannot read recipes.
StMergerMissingTip: Needed for the shared registry of mods. Download it in the build window or in the settings.
StMergerNewTip: A newer ScumRegistryMerger is on GitHub: update it in the settings or in the build window.
FromMod: {0} from the mod|{0} from the mod
NewIngredientSoonText: Creating new products (own name, weight, nutrition, icon) comes in future updates. Updates are checked in the settings.
NoOwnBooks: No own cookbooks yet: "New cookbook" below.
KnownWarning: A recipe of this list stays with characters that already exist forever, even if you remove it from the mod later. To test, use a cookbook: a cookbook recipe is visible only while the player has the book.
EmptyBookWarning: The cookbook has no recipes: add at least one, an empty book gives players nothing.
DeleteBookText: "{0}" leaves the mod with its list of recipes. The recipes themselves stay.
GameBookNote: The game's own recipes cannot be removed from its cookbook: a mod can only add new ones (marked "mod").
KnownBadgeTip: This recipe is in the known-from-the-start list: characters that already exist keep it forever.
KnownSide: Not a cookbook: every new character knows the recipes of this list. The list lives in the game's cooking skill.
OwnIconSoon: Own PNG icon: in future updates.
FoundInWorld: Where it is found in the world
FromScratchDesc: An empty recipe: you set the slots, cookware and time.
CopyOfGameDesc: Your recipe based on a game one; then change what you need.
EnglishOnlyNote: English only for now: names in other languages come in future updates.
OwnModelSoon: The model can be any ready dish of the game. Own FBX model and own PNG icon: in future updates.
NotFoundInWorld: Does not appear in the world yet: players get it only with #SpawnItem (below). Choosing places comes in future updates.
InedibleLoading: Reading the rest of the game's items…
ContainerWhole: This is a container: the game takes it whole with what is in it and leaves nothing behind. To take millilitres, use the liquid "{0}".
CountsContainer: container: goes whole, with what is in it
NoIconWarning: "{0}" has no icon of its own: in the game the slot may show some other picture. It still works: what counts is what you chose.
ModelCount: Models: {0}. Click to look, double-click to choose.
ModelTake: What to take from this model
ModelTakeDishSub: in the inventory, on the ground, in hands
ModelTakeCook: Look in the cookware while cooking
ModelNone: Choose a dish on the left
ModelNoCook: This dish is not cooked in cookware (smoker)
ModelUnreadable: The model could not be read from the game files
ModelViewHint: Left button: rotate · right: move · wheel: zoom · double-click: reset
RegistryHelp: The shared registry has issues. The ScumRegistryMerger window shows each mod's state: for example, a mod built for another game version.
StepRegistryNotNeeded: The shared registry is not needed: no mod in ~mods adds new items, recipes or cookbooks
VisualsTitle: Icons and 3D models from the SCUM client?
VisualsText: SCUM Server ships no pictures: icons and model textures are only in the SCUM client, and it is installed on this PC. Take them from the client? Only for the editor's view: recipes are read from the server, the mod and the server files are not changed. You can change this in the settings (Game).
SetVisualsFromClient: Icons and 3D models from the SCUM client
SetVisualsFromClientDesc: For SCUM Server, which has no textures. Only for the editor's view; the mod is not affected.
GameSwitchTip: The mod is for: {0}. Click to switch to {1} (same key; the mod installs into the chosen game's ~mods).
AlsoClient: Also install the mod into the SCUM client on this PC (its ~mods and shared registry) — to test as a player
ServerAloneOk: A mod for SCUM Server with only cooking time and temperature: the server alone is enough, it cooks with the new time. Players without the mod still see the old time in the cooking window.
ServerNeedsClients: A mod for SCUM Server with changes the player's game checks (ingredients, cookware, new recipes, dishes, cookbooks): they don't work for players without the mod. Players need this mod too.
StEditorNewTip: A new SCUM Recipe Editor on GitHub: Settings → Updates
UpdatingEditor: Downloading SCUM Recipe Editor {0} from GitHub… The program will start again.
UpdateEditorText: The program downloads the new version from GitHub (about 76 MB), closes its windows and starts again. It asks about unsaved edits when closing. Projects and settings stay as they are.
